scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: One reused secret
scenes.caption: The robotics club uses a fictional account for its project board. A notice says a password reused on another service was exposed. Kabir wants to add a number to the old password and continue working immediately.
scenes.dialogue: Changing one character is a weak plan.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Separate the accounts
scenes.caption: Meera explains that a different, long passphrase for each account limits the damage from reuse. They compare invented plans rather than entering secrets. An approved password manager can help, with a responsible adult following school account rules.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Another check
scenes.caption: The club enables an additional sign-in check through its known settings. This makes a stolen password less useful, but does not make the account invincible. A request to approve an unexpected sign-in should be refused and discussed with the teacher.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose a response
scenes.caption: Your decision is whether to keep the reused secret, change only the final digit, or replace it with a unique passphrase and review protection. The teacher supervises the change without asking anyone to share the new secret.
scenes.dialogue: Help does not require knowing your secret.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Plan for losing access
scenes.caption: Recovery is a separate route for getting back in when ordinary sign-in fails. The club checks its approved recovery contact and stores fictional recovery material safely. A second check cannot help if every recovery route has been neglected.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: The device is missing
scenes.caption: Now the sign-in device is unavailable before an exhibition. Use the approved recovery route with the responsible teacher, then review protection again. In practice, distinguish a deliberate sign-in from an unexpected approval request and a recovery attempt.
scenes.dialogue: No real passwords in this lab.
